<title>FICTIONAL EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT — Confidential Information</title>
<page></page>
<section></section>
<passage>Confidential Information means non-public business, customer, pricing, security, financial, personnel, and technical information Elena encounters through work. It excludes information she can show was already lawfully known to her without restriction, becomes public without her breach, is independently developed without using company material, or is received lawfully from a third party. Elena must use Confidential Information only for her duties and protect it with reasonable care. She may disclose information when required by law, court order, or a regulator, and may confidentially report suspected wrongdoing to a lawyer, union representative, law-enforcement body, or government authority. Nothing in this clause prevents a protected whistleblowing disclosure, discussion of Elena's own pay or working conditions, or cooperation with an investigation. On departure, Elena must return company records and delete company copies from personal devices, but she may retain her employment agreement, payslips, performance reviews, and documents reasonably needed to exercise legal rights.</passage>
</source>
